title: Scalable Algorithms for Approximate DNF Model Counting
abstract: arXiv:2601.10511v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Model counting of Disjunctive Normal Form (DNF) formulas is a critical problem in applications such as probabilistic inference and network reliability. For example, it is often used for query evaluation in probabilistic databases. Due to the computational intractability of exact DNF counting, there has been a line of research into a variety of approximation algorithms. These include Monte Carlo approaches such as the classical algorithms of Karp, Luby, and Madras (1989), as well as methods based on hashing (Soos et al. 2023), and heuristic approximations based on Neural Nets (Abboud, Ceylan, and Lukasiewicz 2020).   We develop a new Monte Carlo approach with an adaptive stopping rule and short-circuit formula evaluation. We prove it achieves Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learning bounds and is asymptotically more efficient than the previous methods. We also show experimentally that it out-performs prior algorithms by ord

translated_title: 可扩展的近似DNF（析取范式）模型计数算法
translated_abstract: 析取范式的模型计数是概率推理和网络可靠性等应用中的关键问题，例如常用于概率数据库中的查询评估。由于精确DNF计数在计算上难以处理，研究者们提出了多种近似算法，包括蒙特卡洛方法（如Karp、Luby和Madras于1989年提出的经典算法）、基于哈希的方法（Soos等人，2023）以及基于神经网络的启发式近似方法（Abboud、Ceylan和Lukasiewicz，2020）。本文开发了一种新的蒙特卡洛方法，采用自适应停止规则和短路公式求值技术。我们证明了该方法能够达到概率近似正确的学习界限，并且在渐近意义上比以往方法更高效。实验结果也表明，其性能比先前算法有数量级的提升。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合自适应停止规则与短路求值的新型蒙特卡洛DNF模型计数近似算法，证明了其满足概率近似正确（PAC）保证，且在理论和实验上均显著优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel Monte Carlo algorithm for approximate DNF model counting with an adaptive stopping rule and short-circuit formula evaluation, proving PAC bounds and demonstrating superior efficiency over prior methods both asymptotically and experimentally.
